traces.title: Normal task completion
traces.description: Session started, turn runs, tool calls succeed, turn completes normally.

traces.title: Mobile reply to agent question
traces.description: Agent asks for input, user replies from mobile, message accepted and completed.

traces.title: Stop a running turn
traces.description: User sends Stop while turn is Running. Host accepts, turn transitions Stopping->Cancelled.

traces.title: Permission request with competing decisions
traces.description: Permission requested, two mobile decisions arrive. First valid decision wins, second is rejected as stale.

traces.title: Reconnect after network interruption
traces.description: Client disconnects, reconnects with last_applied_seq, receives missing events, converges to Live.

traces.title: Recovery after compaction boundary
traces.description: Old events compacted away. Client recovers from snapshot at compaction boundary without full event replay.

traces.title: Protocol version incompatibility
traces.description: Older client attempts recovery with newer Host. ERR_VERSION_INCOMPATIBLE returned. Safe operations blocked.

traces.title: OutcomeUnknown after crash during writable tool
traces.description: Host crashes after tool execution but before durable event write. On restart, tool state is OutcomeUnknown. No auto-retry.

traces.title: Interrupt and send new message
traces.description: User sends interrupt_and_send: old turn goes Stopping->Cancelled, then new message accepted and new turn started.
